description: Timezone change: the user (Kenji) has moved from New York to Tokyo; his profile timezone is Asia/Tokyo and the colleague writes every time in his new local time. Written Fri Oct 23, 2026 (Tokyo). 'Monday at 8am' JST is Sunday 23:00 UTC, so the stored instant falls on the previous UTC day while due_date stays the local Monday. Times stated with a zone abbreviation ('3pm GMT') are deliberately absent: see DEFECT T-D3 in tests/unit/tester-dates-timezone.test.ts.
